title: 30 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah Seeks Blessings of HH Mahant Swami Maharaj, Ahmedabad, India
story:
Shri Amit Shah, Union Home Minister of India, visited the BAPS Yogiji Maharaj Hospital, Ahmedabad at 5.10 PM to receive the blessings of Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj. He was garlanded and welcomed by Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj in the presence of Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami, Atmaswarup Swami and Brahmavihari Swami.

Then, prayers for national peace and harmony were offered by the recital of the Vedic Shanti Path. Afterwards, Shri Amit Shah performed the pujan of Shri Aksharpurshottam Maharaj and Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj. Swamishri blessed Shri Amit Shah by applying a chandan chandlo to his forehead, and prayed for the peace, progress and welfare of the nation and all its people - for a Strong India and One India.

Brahmavihari Swami updated Shri Amit Shah about the upcoming month-long Pramukh Swami Maharaj Shatabdi Mahotsav in Ahmedabad, and offered him a special invitation. He was particularly pleased to know that the festival is being organised on 600 acres of land in Ahmedabad, set up by over 80,000 volunteers.

items.text:
Shri Amit Shah, Union Home Minister of India, visited the BAPS Yogiji Maharaj
Hospital, Ahmedabad at 5.10 PM to receive the blessings of Param Pujya Mahant Swami
Maharaj. He was garlanded and welcomed by Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj in the
presence of Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami, Atmaswarup Swami and Brahmavihari Swami.

Then, prayers for national peace and harmony were offered by the recital of the Vedic
Shanti Path. Afterwards, Shri Amit Shah performed the pujan of Shri Aksharpurshottam
Maharaj and Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj. Swamishri blessed Shri Amit Shah by
applying a chandan chandlo to his forehead, and prayed for the peace, progress and
welfare of the nation and all its people, for a Strong India and One India.

Brahmavihari Swami updated Shri Amit Shah about the upcoming month-long
Pramukh Swami Maharaj Shatabdi Mahotsav in Ahmedabad, and offered him a
special invitation. He was particularly pleased to know that the festival is being
organised on 600 acres of land in Ahmedabad, set up by over 80,000 volunteers.

BAPS Tribal Uplift Activities in Sabarkantha District :

From 1982, through the inspiration and efforts of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sadhus, the BAPS has been performing noteworthy services for the uplift of tribal people in the regions Khedbrahma and Poshina. The services are as follows:

Health services : BAPS Medical vans tours the interior tribal regions and treat 300 patients free of cost per day.

Anti-Addiction : as part of its ongoing de-addiction programs a recently held camp was attended by tribals from 70 villages. Beside giving up addictions they also pledged to become vegetarians by not killing and eating goats and buffaloes.

Watershed Projects : BAPS is performing water conservation and harvesting projects in 12 villages.

Education : Literacy drive, scholarships and distribution of notebooks. Mobile education project through a van that will teach tribal children in interior areas is under planning.

Tribal Women's Uplift : To make them self-supporting they are provided with means to help them grow vegetables and earn a living. Special programs for education and anti-addiction are also held for women.

Relief Works : In times of famine the BAPS has organized cattle camps, fodder distribution, food distribution, etc.

Character Building : Through weekly satsang assemblies, and personal contact the tribals are inspired with moral and spiritual values and pride for Hinduism.

Superstitions and Bad Customs : To abolish superstitions and vices personal contact by volunteers inspires faith in God.

Rather than how long a person lives, it is the quality of life that one lives which is important. (16 Nov. 02)

The more profound one's devotion to God, the purer one's thoughts become. If one's diet is pure then one gets pure thoughts. If however one tends to kill then one gets violent thoughts. (16 Nov. 02)

God is the doer and not us. Because we believe that we are the doer there is Iness and Miness, deceit and quarrels.(19 Nov. 02)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
